column1:
The Intel Code of Conduct 
and annual Code training 
materials reference human 
rights, and our Philosophy 
on Protecting Personal 
Information supplements  
our Online Privacy Notice
column2:
We conduct annual  
reviews and audits of  
our own facilities, policies, 
and practices
column3:
Our Board of Directors  
and senior management 
provide oversight
column4:
Our annual Corporate 
Responsibility Report 
provides updates on our 
performance, and our CSR 
and Public Policy blogs 
periodically cover human 
rights issues

column1:
We set expectations for our 
suppliers to comply with 
the EICC Code of Conduct 
and to maintain progressive 
employment practices
column2:
Our robust risk-based 
assessment and audit process 
for suppliers covers human 
rights issues
column3:
Our capacity-building 
initiatives address systemic 
human rights challenges in 
the electronics supply chain
column4:
We regularly engage with 
socially responsible investors, 
NGOs, and other stakeholders 
around human rights issues

column1:
Our Privacy by Design and 
Secure Development Life-
cycle processes are designed 
to ensure integration of 
security and privacy into  
our products and services
column2:
The Intel Privacy and Product 
Security Group oversees 
compliance activities for our 
information assets, products, 
and services
column3:
We work to increase digital 
inclusion and education 
access, and educate 
consumers on privacy  
and security
column4:
Our Privacy Advisory Board 
of external privacy experts 
provides guidance to our 
Privacy and Product  
Security Group
